title: Live stage paths: drive all eight cycle stages through CycleRunner in the stage driver
goal: Replace the six remaining LiveModeIntegrationPendingError refusals in packages/adapters/src/app/stage-driver.mjs with real execute paths so a liveMode true cycle runs end to end: funding, outbound, return and payout on Robinhood Chain (calldata from hook-contract-client, signed through the operator signer client from WP-33, broadcast through robinhood-rpc, observed until CycleRunner's production profile accepts the evidence); buyback on Solana (collector-crypt buyback with the card mint from the open evidence, signed and broadcast through the Solana operator signer client and solana-rpc); distribution through snapshot-indexer, pro-rata, the distribution signer client and the verifier receipts written by hookemon-verifier; every stage follows the stage-by-stage call surface in docs/modules/cycle-runner.md, records the broadcast before observing, and never re-broadcasts a transaction whose signature is already recorded. Purchase and open keep their existing live paths but move onto CycleRunner evidence as well, so the parallel journal in cycle-repository.mjs disappears except for the stage-attempt record.
writeSet: packages/adapters/src/*.mjs (smallest missing adapter function only, with a test)
docs/modules/index.json (only the sha256 entry of docs/modules/composition-root.md)
readSet: docs/modules/cycle-runner.md (stage-by-stage call surface; follow it literally)
packages/adapters/src/signing/*.mjs (WP-33 signer clients and standing authority)
packages/runner/src/automation/automated-cycle-service.mjs (reconcile returns null until the mutation is durably done)
steps: Split stage-driver.mjs into one module per stage under packages/adapters/src/app/stages, each exporting probe (liveMode false) and execute plus reconcile (liveMode true) following the call surface table

Robinhood stages: build calldata with hook-contract-client, sign with the operator EVM signer client, broadcast with robinhood-rpc, then observe receipts and logs and translate them into the runner's canonical evidence envelope; the vault inputs come from the WP-34 frozen control

Solana buyback: getBuybackAvailable for the mint from the open evidence, build the buyback request through collector-crypt, sign and broadcast through the Solana operator signer client and solana-rpc, observe the transaction and translate it into the envelope

Distribution: snapshot holders at the cycle block through snapshot-indexer, compile the pro-rata manifest, obtain the distribution approval through the distribution signer client, wait for the verifier receipt written by hookemon-verifier, then hand the pair to settlement-worker for the payout stage
Idempotency: a broadcast signature is recorded durably before observation; on retry the stage resumes observation instead of re-broadcasting; crash-and-resume tests between every pair of stages

Tests with fake transports and throwing signer stubs: a full liveMode true cycle runs all eight stages; a liveMode false cycle never reaches sign or broadcast; run the adapters suite, the runner suite, the dashboard suite, scripts/tests and the clean-room scanner before the single commit; update docs/modules/composition-root.md and only its digest in docs/modules/index.json
tests: cd packages/adapters && npm ci --ignore-scripts && node --test test/**/*.test.mjs
acceptance: No LiveModeIntegrationPendingError remains; a liveMode true cycle with fake transports runs all eight stages through CycleRunner's production profile to a settled payout
With liveMode false no code path reaches sign or broadcast (throwing stubs)
Crash-and-resume between every pair of stages never double-spends and never re-broadcasts a recorded signature
All suites green; clean-room scanner green; packages/runner and packages/dashboard keep zero npm dependencies
notes: R4: fresh-context reviewer mandatory; the reviewer must reproduce the liveMode false proof and the crash-and-resume proof and must check that no key material is read anywhere.
